links.to_node: make passengers vote for 10 passengers to send overboard
I conduct a vote among the passengers to select 10 individuals to leave the overcrowded lifeboat.
10 passengers are sent overboard into the cold water
The overcrowded lifeboat's risk of sinking decreases
The remaining passengers on the overcrowded lifeboat have an increased chance of survival
My lifeboat remains at full capacity with no additional passengers
Passengers experience emotional distress and grief over the decision and loss of life
Tension and conflict may arise among passengers due to the forced vote and outcome
I face moral and ethical consequences for ordering the vote and sending passengers overboard
